findings.passage: We must continue to modernize our elections, while making it easier to register to vote and cast a ballot.
findings.note: Quote attributed to Bucy in his own press release on his 88th-session bills. Text taken through the fetch tool (curl was blocked).
HB 354, caption 'Relating to acceptable forms of identification for voting.' Filed 2022-11-14; referred to House Elections 2023-02-23; stayed in committee.

HB 2082, caption 'Relating to ensuring access to the right to vote by all eligible voters.' Per the bill text, it widens the accepted photo IDs (higher-education, state agency, tribal, IDs expired up to four years), widens non-photo documents with a reasonable-impediment declaration, and adds same-day, automatic and online registration with identity checks. Filed 2025-01-24; referred to House Elections 2025-03-14; stayed in committee. Summary of bill text came through the fetch tool.
